note: Filtered sample: all 2,080 written reviews the Play Store's own review data returned (newest first) were read in the built-in browser; only the 36 that contain a family or caregiving word AND a word about help, requests, meals, tasks, calendar, invites, privacy, visitors, access, sign-in, joining or following are saved here. Some may repeat reviews already in google-play-reviews-caringbridge.json (deduplicated by text when combined). Reviewer names omitted. Not a random sample.

reviews.text: The app was never great, but it served its purpose. Since the recent update (June 2024) I can no longer log in at all. If I click on the Facebook option to log in, I immediately get an error message without even being able to enter any information. The error I get is "Your Facebook email is unavailable. Contact customer care to resolve." I'm a co-author on a site for my dad while he battles pancreatic cancer, and the last thing I need is login issues on a stupid app.
❤Helps concerned loved ones, who live far away from the family member undergoing treatment, stay informed & offer support.
As a grandparent this site is so helpful in keeping in touch. This is so much easier for my daughter and son-in-law to send updates to friends and family in one message.

I like this app for ease of use and because visitors can get information without having to sign up. I do wish the meal train was included on this site rather than a third-party site. As a caregiver, that would make coordinating all aspects of care easier. I have used other care sites that include this feature. With that said, I deeply appreciate this site and all that it allows me to do!

I have used caringbridge to follow several friends and family members' situations. It has helped us keep informed, connected and I cannot say enough good things about being able to share info without compromising health and also being able to provide love and comfort to your loved one's as they go through tough times.
The caring bridge app has allowed so many people to follow the progress of a friend and family member who was badly burned 3 weeks ago. Without it i don't know how that would happen so easily!!

Ths app has been a God-send during my dad's month long journey through emergency back surgery and subsequent complications. I just sent one email with the Caring Bridge link to everyone who might be interested in following his progress. They can choose for themselves whether or not to receive all of the updates, and I only have to send one post when it's time to update. Also, There are two of us posting to the site so we can avoid sending duplicate updates.
So helpful with communication to those who care about the illness or condition of a loved one.
Caring Bridge makes it easy for many people to follow the progress of a friend or family member without bothering the family or individual with innumerable texts and emails.

Caring Bridge is the absolute best option available to keep friends and family up to date on the developments of a loved one during a health crisis. Everyone that loves us and that we love, wants to be informed of the latest updates regarding our medical journey and we want them to know. But at the end of an exhausting day, no one wants to answer dozens of email and texts. Caring Bridge assures that everyone gets the same information at the same time. That's the kind of help we need most.

Due to my wife's unexpected pancreatic cancer, I had literally 100+ people wanting updates on her condition. This app allowed me to accomplish the task with a single daily post. I can't say enough good things about this application. We're blessed enough by it to willingly provide any donations to help support it.
This is a wonderful site. It makes it possible for me to follow the progress of a friend or loved one while they are recovering.
A wonderful tol to speak privately about a loved one to a select hroup of people.

For anyone who has had a loved one suffering from a medical issue this app is a Godsend. Easy to read and post the latest medical issue or breakthrough in one place. It helps keep everyone informed without constant back and forth calls.

We have used this service a couple of times now for critical medical events. Family and friends have told us MANY times how much they value the ability to get updates regularly. It's easy to manage and use, limiting access to those we approve, and has been so valuable in limiting the time we spend on requests for info so that we can focus on our loved one. I highly recommend this service/app and am deeply grateful for it!

Thanks to CaringBridge, our family and friends can be updated about my husband's progress through a very difficult surgery and recovery. It has really cut down the amount of individual communication so I don't have to say the same info to multiple people which is a tedious caregiver task during hospitalizations.

This app is well run, helpful, organized. It fills a vital need in communicating a family member's healing journey to those who love & care about & pray for that person. It was a God-send for our daughter & many others that we know! Thank you for making it available!
Caring Bridge has been great to update friends and family around the country about my husband's accident. My cousin in Australia doesn't seem to have access. Is it only a US thing?
Awesome service, helps family members keep up with all the progress their family member is making!!!!!‽

A great way to keep in contact and share a difficult time. Prevents excessive calls and disturbances, because we can get a feel for how good or bad a day is going. Keeps the tender and raw moments within a chosen group instead of the whole internet gawking. My 85 year young mama can catch up from her phone and see the pictures- very helpful to visit without the long travel. Thanks for this platform!!

This app deserves the best rating! My Uncle is recovering from a heart and kidney transplant and it helps to keep us all up to date on his progress so we don't have to worry or call my Aunt too much when she is busy in the hospital with him. Thank you for helping to keep us all connected during a difficult time ❤

Caring Bridge is a huge help to families with loved ones in serious or prolonged illness or injury. Sure beats all the texts and phone calls at a time when the family is swamped with other tasks related to their loved one's care. So grateful for Caring Bridge. I've made donations and highly recommend other users do the same.
Smooth and easy to use. Good to help my father in law connect with everyone during a hard time.
Has been helpful in the support and love my family member has received during their hospital stay.
It's an easy to use app that has been great for helping us keep friends and family updated on my husband's cancer journey.

As I was faced with the news that the cancer had returned and it was widespread, I was informed of Caring Bridge by my mother who does not use social media and couldn't see my Facebook posts. Caring Bridge also allows me to update everyone and not have to "friend" everyone on Facebook. Leaving Facebook for a place of enjoyment. Having co-authors takes the responsibility off of me organizing meals, transportation and fundraising! Thank you Caring Bridge!!

This app has helped me keep all of my family and friends informed and brought so much relief to me as a spouse to try and care for my husband, take care of important concerns (medically and financially) while giving me a break for my own self care. I cannot express my gratitude for the use of this app! Glory be to God to helping me find a way to manage everything as I face these trying times!!! ✝️🙏❤🙏✝️

So far its exactly what my family needs !! My mom is still able to live alone (at 91 yrs old !) But lately her dementia has affected her self- care. So My 5 siblings and her 12 grandkids, are trying to coordinate being there for her when she needs someone. This app is helping her continue to live independently, for as long as possible. Thank you CaringBridge !!

This app is an amazing way to keep family and friends updated when a loved one is going through an illness or any medical condition. It is an amazing resource to update in real time and eliminate miscommunication. It has several other features such as a calendar for others to use to help support loved one and their family and options for linking in meal train and go fund me links. Truly 10stars!
This site has been a huge help as my husband battled with cancer. If enabled us to contact more people than we could imagine and reach out to encourage others.

When my son had a health event, our (his parents) ears felt like they were falling off and phones were running out of battery trying to keep everyone up to date on what was going on. My dear friend and son's godmother mentioned Caringbridge to us and what a Godsend it is! Thank you Caringbridge for helping us through this very difficult time! My son's spirits were boosted by all of the feedback and encouragement he received. We cannot thank you enough!
This app is such a blessing. Such a great resource to help people cope, send thoughts, prayers, love, and more importantly, allows the family to keep their focus on the loved one.

I really like caring bridge when I access it on my computer- it's a phenomenal way to keep family/friends updated. But this phone app leaves so much to be desired. It is not easy to navigate. I'm having trouble downloading photos . It frequently gives me the "circle of thinking/ indecision". I don't need the extra stress of dealing with a faulty app when I'm dealing with a critically ill family member.

Caring Bridge is a wonderful way for everyone who is invited to join, family, friends and neighbors, to stay connected to any progress . It takes the load of single or group texts off the shoulders of the main loved one. This is my third experience with Caring Bridge. Thank you

I'm dissapointed. As a parent with a sick child, I rely on this app to help make my notifying our friends and family easier. The app constantly messes up or deletes my posts. I cannot post a photo on it without the app turning the photo sideways or upside down, no matter what the format or orientation of the original picture is. I cannot connect to GoFundMe through it either. Dissapointing.
My mom has stage 4 brain cancer. This has helped a lot to keep my parents phone calls to a min. Was really great while she was in surgery
